original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write a complete operation alphabet outside one named premise and price a baseline before searching identities.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: In F2[Dic_3] on exactly three registers, using only the charged address generators u and v and all 28 binary rank-one idempotents, exhaustively test whether any diagonal monomial endpoint triple with separate generator cost at least six has an exact word of at most five paid calls. Record the completed depth-four subcensus at direct cost at least five as the evidence-driven first stage.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue's broad changed-operation-alphabet question is refined to the order-12 dicyclic presentation, a two-letter paid alphabet, and a complete finite endpoint layer. After the full depth-four search found no saving for 1,482 targets, one bounded pivot raises the call ceiling by one while retaining a one-call minimum saving (direct bill at least six versus at most five).
bottleneck_link: This is a side result testing whether noncommuting address words can share paid calls across diagonal outputs. It changes no selected supplier or kappa unless a later construction is routed into the bit interface and fully repriced.
stop_rule: Exhaust all 56 paid operation types and all 1,728 diagonal monomial triples, checking every word of length at most four for each triple whose separate positive-generator bill is at least five, then every word of length at most five for each triple whose bill is at least six. Stop after those two exact coefficientwise searches and their controls; do not enlarge the group or depth in this cycle.
evidence: Exact finite search finds no word of at most four calls for any of 1,482 diagonal triples with direct bill at least five, and no word of at most five calls for any of 1,230 triples with bill at least six. Coverage digests are a1398353921f55628c8329852554a6538f2a075eccc51ae127e25bfc791727f3 and 816765d363f764fdaf4b3cbe4f1bc10ed235fc664924ea11a4112046d2157a1b. Exact group, alphabet, baseline and controls pass.
